## Problem / motivation

What accessibility issue or workflow problem are you trying to solve?
("I'm trying to…, but…")

## Proposed solution

Describe your idea. If you're suggesting a new check or fix, describe:

- Whether it should auto-fix or only report.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought of and why you ruled them out.
